newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Beter Bed IPO priced at 28 guilders/share.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Beter Bed IPO priced at 28 guilders/share.

text.p: The initial public offering of four million shares in bedroom furniture chain Beter Bed Holding NV was priced at 28.00 guilders per share, ABN AMRO Rothschild said.

ABN AMRO Rothschild said the offering had been oversubscribed some 15 times and that the shares had been allocated in roughly equal amounts to Dutch institutions, foreign institutions and Dutch private investors.
The issue price was set at the top of the indicative range of 25 to 28 guilders announced last week.
ABN AMRO Rothschild said it had been granted an option by the selling shareholders to acquire an additional 600,000 shares up to 30 days after the payment date of December 5.
Beter Bed shares are due to start trading on the Amsterdam bourse at 1130 GMT on Monday.
